map.计算数值的百分比、占比、增长率等: Calculates percentages, proportions and growth rates of values
map.百分比三种算法：求百分比值 = a × b ÷ 100；求占比 = a ÷ b: Three percentage methods: value = a × b ÷ 100; ratio = a ÷ b × 100%; change rate = (b − a) ÷ a × 100% and show the change amount (b − a).
map.前向运动占比 = 40/100×100% = 40%，高于 WHO PR≥32%: PR proportion = 40/100×100% = 40%, above the WHO PR≥32% reference.
map.正常形态率 = 8/200×100% = 4%，达 WHO 严格标准 ≥4% 临: Normal morphology rate = 8/200×100% = 4%, at the WHO strict criterion ≥4% borderline.
map.本器做通用占比；专用器按 WHO 字段自动套阈值与判读。: This tool does general proportions; the dedicated tool auto-applies WHO thresholds and interpretation.
map.总数须>0，否则无法计算占比。: Total must be >0; otherwise proportion cannot be computed.
